kraken_prop.program_scope: Kraken Pro Prop / Breakout 1-Step evaluations and corresponding funded stage
kraken_prop.simulation_blocker: Historical executable Kraken Prop bid/ask/liquidity/slippage path for the DH-03 2023-2024 replay window is not available as a frozen official historical series. Official rules explicitly state spread/liquidity can vary and OKX/Bybit are only proxies that do not always align. Do not substitute Binance close prices as Kraken Prop fills.

governing_contract_chain.kraken_terms: Kraken Prop users must accept Breakout Evaluation Terms; those terms govern evaluation process, fees and outcomes. Passing traders sign a Funded Trader Agreement with Payward Oceanic.

daily_loss.calculation: balance at 00:30 UTC minus 3%; balance excludes open positions when setting the floor; intraday equity including open positions is monitored against the floor
daily_loss.breach_condition: equity reaches or falls through the daily loss floor

inactivity.effect: evaluation access is suspended until reactivation is requested; this is not encoded as a permanent drawdown breach

trading_hours_and_holding.news_trading: allowed without a separate news restriction, subject to data/pricing liquidity availability

fees_and_carry.breakout_terminal_charge_frequency: six times per day, once every four hours
fees_and_carry.interpretation: The number of four-hour funding intervals can be determined only after an exact terminal charging schedule/anchor is authoritative. Do not choose an anchor after seeing outcomes.

spread_liquidity_execution.liquidity_sources: third-party brokers, market makers, exchanges and other crypto liquidity providers
spread_liquidity_execution.official_proxy_warning: proxy pairs do not always perfectly align with Breakout symbols

kraken_prop.current_cap_warning: Leverage and position caps are dynamic and reviewed against market conditions; current values are a 2026-09-17 snapshot, not historical 2023-2024 values.

kyc.evaluation: basic Kraken verification (email + country) is sufficient for purchase/trading according to current Kraken support
kyc.funded: full Kraken identity verification and Funded Trader Agreement required

eligibility.reason: Kraken terms state availability is jurisdiction-dependent and may be restricted or withdrawn. Absence from the public exclusion list is not treated as a purchase authorization.

prohibited_strategy_relevance.warning: Breakout prohibits third-party/off-the-shelf approaches marketed to pass evaluations and approaches difficult to replicate live. PROP-COMPAT-001 must therefore treat the setup as the user's independently frozen research rule and must not alter it specifically to pass the evaluation.

remaining_material_blockers: Historical executable spread/liquidity/slippage path for 2023-2024 DH-03 replay is unavailable from an authoritative Kraken Prop/Breakout historical source.
Exact four-hour funding charge clock anchors for Breakout Terminal are not explicitly stated in the retrieved public rule text; only frequency is stated.
Current leverage/position caps cannot be silently projected backward to 2023-2024; for compatibility testing they may be treated as current operational constraints, not historical venue facts.

next_allowed_work: Resolve or pre-freeze a defensible executable-price/spread proxy protocol without opening risk-grid outcomes.
Resolve Breakout Terminal four-hour funding clock anchors from an official source if available.
Continue TFG evidence recovery without reconstructing trades from aggregates.
